Four days before the 7 November telling, and he notes he has said it many times.
Useful because it is his audience pushing back, in their words, and his answer to them.

The one to check hardest in the whole batch. He claims a window, from the 23rd of September on, and offers the Charlie Kirk killing as the fulfilment. That killing was on 10 September, thirteen days before the window he says he was given. The mismatch is recorded in falsify_miss and goes to the evidence pass rather than being resolved here.
calling-things-that-be-not applied to money. Linked by a system edge.
The shrug is the interesting part: if the Lord shows more about the doors that is good, and if not something else will come. The sight is not guaranteed to arrive on schedule.
He says three months, counts the months out loud, and corrects himself to four. Recorded with the correction intact.
Soon, with no date. The hymn that follows is described rather than reproduced.

He raises December 31st and withdraws it in the same breath, on the in-part clause, then prays over Times Square. That is the pattern to watch: a date is put in the audience's mind and the responsibility for it is set down at once.
